scenarios.name: Retain a staged ribbon edit while viewing marking menu customization

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the customization dialog is open on Ribbon for an empty Part Tools custom panel
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel without applying
the user selects the Marking Menu customization tab
the marking menu customization controls are displayed
the user returns to the Ribbon customization tab
"2D Sketches" remains in the Part Tools target list
the target is marked as changed
the user cancels the customization dialog
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
